title: Configure Values not applied on page refresh
body: Bug: What is the current behavior? - Set a value on configure - Change is reflected: - Refresh the page, results not using the value: react-instantsearch 3.1.0 P.S. I know I said it was working before, but it's not currently. I might have accidentally thought it was working.

comments.body: @zackify: can you share a sample of code showing how you actually parse your configure parameters and build your `<InstantSearch/>` instance with `<Configure/>` ?
You can do so with this: https://jsfiddle.net/vvoyer/ar80rgpc/2/

Sorry, didn't notice the replies. The configure widget has no props on a page reload, the data is just in the search state in the url. Shouldn't it still be added to the search state even though configure is empty on a page load?

I can try to make an example monday if that doesn't help.

We made the Configure widget so that there's only one way to have parameters applied: you have to set props on it.

So the best option is to read them from the state then forward them to the Configure widget. I understand this is then not consistent with other widgets like Menu which will take the refined value into account.

We will have to revisit this later on then.

The way configure behaved will be improved later, see https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/issues/1955.

I'm closing this one in the mean time.
